Hi, I'm **Geoffrey Barini** — I work on remote sensing and GeoAI, with a focus on
geospatial large language models (GeoLLMs) for Earth observation.

**Interests:** land-cover mapping · change detection · vision-language models for satellite imagery · GeoAI agents

**Tools:** Python · Google Earth Engine · PyTorch · rasterio / xarray · QGIS · MapLibre
